title: Data sources for the word lists

entities.title: Málið.is
entities.summary: The Árni Magnússon Institute's portal; one JSON lookup per word returns its entries in all the sources below. Every word was verified through it.
entities.relevance: All lookups went through https://malid.is/api_proxy/<word>. No terms published; robots.txt allows crawling.

entities.title: Íslensk nútímamálsorðabók (ÍNO)
entities.summary: Contemporary Icelandic dictionary. Its 2023 dataset gave the senses, gender and compound split of the common nouns, and 1,585 definitions in the rare-word list.
entities.citation: Íslensk nútímamálsorðabók. Halldóra Jónsdóttir og Þórdís Úlfarsdóttir (ritstj.). Reykjavík: Stofnun Árna Magnússonar í íslenskum fræðum.
entities.relevance: The 2023-12 CLARIN-IS dataset (http://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12537/318) is CC BY-SA 4.0; it was used to find candidate words labelled old or rare. The 2026 release is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and was not used. Entry links: https://islenskordabok.arnastofnun.is/ord/<id>. Its robots.txt disallows bots other than the big search engines.

entities.title: Íslensk-dönsk orðabók (Sigfús Blöndal, 1920–24)
entities.summary: Icelandic–Danish dictionary, rich in old and regional words. Source of 156 definitions (Danish glosses translated and paraphrased).
entities.relevance: No licence published; the site says the digital edition is open to all free of charge. Entry links: https://blondal.arnastofnun.is/faersla/<id>. Its robots.txt disallows bots other than the big search engines.

entities.title: Íslensk orðsifjabók (Ásgeir Blöndal Magnússon)
entities.summary: Etymological dictionary shown on málið.is. Source of 37 definitions.
entities.relevance: No terms found; definitions are paraphrased and linked to the málið.is page.

entities.title: Íðorðabankinn
entities.summary: The institute's term bank. Source of 18 definitions.
entities.relevance: No terms found; definitions are paraphrased and linked to the málið.is page.

entities.title: ISLEX
entities.summary: Icelandic–Nordic dictionary; its translations were evidence for 4 definitions.
entities.citation: ISLEX. Þórdís Úlfarsdóttir (aðalritstj.). Reykjavík: Stofnun Árna Magnússonar í íslenskum fræðum.

entities.title: Ritmálssafn Orðabókar Háskólans
entities.summary: Corpus of written citations; its count and age of citations were a signal of how obscure a word is.
entities.citation: Ritmálssafn Orðabókar Háskólans. Stofnun Árna Magnússonar í íslenskum fræðum.
entities.relevance: No terms published. Used only as a signal, not for definitions.

entities.title: Frequency lists for Icelandic 23.06 (Icelandic Gigaword Corpus)
entities.summary: Lemma counts over the Icelandic Gigaword Corpus; used as a signal for how familiar a word is when sampling candidates and scoring difficulty.
entities.relevance: CC BY 4.0 (CLARIN-IS). Used as a familiarity signal and to check that grid words and example answers exist; nothing from it is shown in a game.

entities.title: Vocabulary lists for Icelandic CEFR levels
entities.summary: Icelandic vocabulary sorted into CEFR levels A1–B2. Source of the candidate nouns for the common-noun list and of the word forms in the one-syllable list; for the rare-word list it was used to leave out basic vocabulary.
